decisions.reason: As a low-cost incremental component that supports the installed radiant-heater base, it still has service and attachment value and there is no clear reason to withdraw it.
As the flagship electric infrared line with several models and a strong fit to the firm's electrification path, its strategic option value remains very high.

After two years, this halogen variant looks more like an overlapping niche offer outside the main integrated-climate direction, so the firm would likely rationalize it and redeploy resources elsewhere.
This industrial electric hall-heater line stays close to core customers and applications, so in a growing HVAC machinery firm it remains worth backing absent clear failure.
